requirement.original: Fix check-budget-overage.py crash when plan uses CNY instead of EUR
requirement.clarified: Extend check-budget-overage.py to resolve overage and percentage values from CNY-named fields (overage_cny, overage_percent) and their known nested paths (data.trip_summary, data.days[*].budget_vs_user), in addition to the existing EUR-named fields, so the script does not exit 2 for valid CNY plans.
requirement.what: Multi-currency field resolution in check-budget-overage.py so CNY plans exit 0 or 1 instead of 2
requirement.why: CNY travel plans (e.g. wangfujing-dongdan-beijing) fail the budget overage check with exit code 2 because their overage fields use different names and nesting from the hard-coded EUR lookups

included: Extend field-lookup logic to accept overage_cny and overage_percent as alternatives to overage_eur and overage_percentage
Search data.trip_summary as an additional candidate path
Search data.days[*].budget_vs_user as an additional candidate path
Apply EUR threshold via CNY->EUR conversion when currency_exchange_rate.cny_to_eur is present
Skip absolute EUR threshold (apply only percentage threshold) when no exchange rate is available
Update error message to list all accepted field names and paths
excluded: Generating or patching missing overage fields in budget.json files
Support for currencies other than EUR and CNY

success_criteria: Invoking script on wangfujing-dongdan-beijing-20260405-192905/budget.json exits 0 or 1, not 2
Invoking script on beijing-exchange-bucket-list-20260202-232405/budget.json continues to exit 0 or 1
Invoking script on china-exchange-bucket-list-2026/budget.json exits 2 with an error message listing all accepted field names
No ZeroDivisionError when currency_exchange_rate.cny_to_eur is absent or zero
constraints: No new third-party dependencies — stdlib only
Must preserve existing exit code semantics: 0=acceptable, 1=review required, 2=error
Must not lower the percentage or EUR thresholds

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Script exits 2 with 'Error: Missing overage_eur or overage_percentage' when run against CNY plans
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: check_budget_overage() hard-codes the field names overage_eur and overage_percentage and only searches three paths (root, summary, data). CNY plans store these values as overage_cny / overage_percent under data.trip_summary or data.days[*].budget_vs_user — none of which match the hard-coded lookups.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — no single commit introduced the bug; the script was authored for EUR-only plans and CNY plan structures evolved independently
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Script was written when only EUR-denominated plans existed. CNY plan shapes were added later by the budget agent without updating the check script.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The script's field-detection logic is not exhaustive: it only handles overage_eur / overage_percentage under root/summary/data, while CNY plans use overage_cny / overage_percent under data.trip_summary.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: CNY trip_summary shape appeared at latest by 2026-04-05 (wangfujing plan). EUR shape with CNY conversion in data existed from at least 2026-02-02 (beijing-exchange plan).

context.codebase_state: scripts/check-budget-overage.py is modified (M) on master branch as of 2026-04-05

dependencies.note: Only the beijing-exchange plan embeds an exchange rate; wangfujing and others do not

development_approach.strategy: Extend the existing sequential field-lookup blocks in check_budget_overage() to also probe overage_cny and overage_percent under data.trip_summary and data (peer to overage_eur). After resolving the absolute overage value, detect whether it is in CNY: if currency_exchange_rate.cny_to_eur is present and nonzero, convert to EUR for threshold comparison; otherwise skip the absolute EUR threshold and apply only the percentage threshold. Update error message to list all accepted variants.
key_changes: Add overage_cny lookup in the overage_eur block (same three paths + data.trip_summary)
Add overage_percent lookup in the overage_percentage block (same three paths + data.trip_summary)
Add data.days[0].budget_vs_user as a fourth candidate path for both fields
After extracting values, resolve currency: if field name ends in _cny, set is_cny=True
If is_cny and exchange rate present and nonzero: overage_for_eur_check = overage_abs / rate
If is_cny and no exchange rate: skip absolute EUR threshold (eur_exceeded = False)
Update the None-check error message to list: overage_eur, overage_cny, overage_percentage, overage_percent
Update the output print lines to show the actual currency symbol/code dynamically
development_approach.validation_approach: Run script against all four known budget.json files and verify exit codes: beijing-exchange->0 or 1, wangfujing->0 or 1, china-exchange->2 with updated error, china-feb15->2 with updated error

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause: hard-coded field names that do not match CNY plan field naming conventions. No architectural decisions or novel patterns involved.
